MINIM

How much time passed? How much did you feel?

A Figma prototype that visualizes the gap between perceived and elapsed time. Created for FigBuild 2026, MINIM uses gentle reflection, collectible cards, and expressive characters to make time perception tangible.

Role
UI/UX Design, Branding & Figma Prototyping
Tools
Figma Design, Figma Slides
Team
Tina Jiang, Psychea Dai, Jyue-An Yao

The moment of realization.

The proposed flow asks people to estimate how long they have been scrolling, then reveals the elapsed time. Neutral wording and a carefully paced reveal help the comparison feel reflective rather than judgmental.

Turning a number into something personal.

Each session becomes a daily card with a deviation score and a character. A weekly calendar and a 365-dot year view let people explore patterns in how they experience time.

A visual system with a softer voice.

I worked on the interface, branding, character design, and core interaction flows. Organic vector characters and a warm dark palette bring personality to a structure grounded in familiar iOS components. The project was designed and prototyped in Figma.
